audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0-6].side are ALL flat "Skill", but content win[0-5]="Xerath", win[6]="Morgana", matching the packet levelChart exactly. Xerath is stated as the hardest lane in content.early but the full-layer chart doesn't reflect it at all.
audit.why: Xerath's charged Q (750 range but pokes from further via charge), W AoE slow, and E stun (13-11s CD) out-range and out-poke Morgana's kit until Morgana gets items to punish his total lack of mobility, exactly as content whys[0..6] already state.
audit.corrected: phases[0-5].side -> Xerath, phases[6].side -> Morgana, ratings lowered early to reflect enemy favour, why text rewritten to match the grounded content reasoning.

audit.whatIsWrong: content spikes[1].text calls Xerath's ultimate "Rite of the Ancients" — the real name per enemyAbilities.R and the kit is "Rite of the Arcane".
audit.why: Kit data is authoritative on ability names; Rite of the Ancients is not a real League ability.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text corrected to "Rite of the Arcane".

audit.why: Level 2 (charged Q/W poke), level 6 (three-shot R), first item (W-E-Q burst threatening the ADC), and late (his zero mobility) spikes are already correctly and specifically stated.

edits.before: W-chip the pair — the pool taxes bot's formations politely from one.
edits.after: Charged Q out-ranges your Bind and pokes you for free at level 1.

edits.before: Q threats begin: the three-second root is the lane's longest sentence.
edits.after: His Q-W poke and slow zone you off the wave entirely at level 2.

edits.before: Full kit: the black shield pre-answers their entire support's kit.
edits.after: E stun plus poke pins you with no safe trade window through 3.

edits.before: Bank the root and shield the engage attempts — the lane plays at your Q's pleasure.
edits.after: Ramping artillery damage and combo threat dominate levels 4-5.

edits.before: Soul Shackles online — close-range fights end in a double stun you started.
edits.after: His three-shot R out-ranges Soul Shackles and controls the fight.

edits.before: First item: the root converts and the shields multiply.
edits.after: His W-E-Q burst threatens your ADC and beats a single Shield.

edits.before: Late Morgana erases playbooks: black-shield the engage's target and root the diver who insisted.
edits.after: His zero mobility lets flash-Bind or Zhonya's Shackles execute him.

edits.before: W the pair, bank the Q visibly, shield the answer — the threat governs while the pool bills.
edits.after: Body-block the charged Q with your own frame to protect your ADC.

edits.before: Q-poking into shields while their hook waits for yours to be down — the binding is the law; spend it like one.
edits.after: Don't waste Black Shield on the W tag — bank it for the E stun that starts his combo.

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and the artillery never converts. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your E Black Shield answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Shocking Orb (E) is 13-11s CD by rank — his only CC. Dodge it and the artillery never converts. - Your E Black Shield answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.

edits.before: His R (Rite of the Ancients) fires three long-range shots that can zone or pick from a full screen away, while your R forces you into his kill zone; Black Shield can eat one stun but not the whole barrage, so he dictates the 6 spike.
edits.after: His R (Rite of the Arcane) fires three long-range shots that can zone or pick from a full screen away, while your R forces you into his kill zone; Black Shield can eat one stun but not the whole barrage, so he dictates the 6 spike.
